proves.claim: The runner service installer path is not covered by the fs lint while a sibling file in its folder is, and its program text reports nothing with no ceiling entry.

gate.logic-adapter-lints-fs.generated-ch.why: The installer is sent to a runner as program text that imports node:fs itself, so the lint exempts that one file by exact path and no sibling.

proves.claim: The fs lint run over this checkout with the setting on returns no row naming the runner service installer or the slots module.

gate.logic-adapter-lints-fs.real-tree-ge.why: Without a real-tree run the exemption and the removed ceiling rows could pass their unit case yet fail the lint that runs in the gate.
